## About
Odds & Ends Home Services is a home improvement business focused on Tuxedo and Tuxedo Park, New York, plus all of neighboring Rockland County. Founded in 2001 by Daniel Kiely, the business has grown from trusted handyman work into small and medium sized renovations — kitchens, bathrooms, basements, accent walls, custom built-ins, decks, flooring, and home offices — while still welcoming the small repair jobs that built its name. Dan is known for meticulous attention to detail, creative problem-solving, honest pricing, and leaving every workspace cleaner than he found it. The business has a perfect 5-star rating on Google.

## Signature Project Categories
- Kitchens — cabinets, countertops, backsplash, lighting, full kitchen updates
- Bathrooms — vanities, tile, fixtures, full small-bath renovations
- Basements — moisture-first basement finishing and refreshes
- Accent Walls — board-and-batten, shiplap, feature walls
- Custom Built-Ins — bookcases, window seats, media walls
- Deck Repair & Refinishing — repairs, sanding, staining, sealing
- Flooring — hardwood, LVP, and tile installation
- Home Offices — built-in desks, shelving, finished work spaces
- General Handyman Services — everything below
